rationale: Both Lydia and Sid work in developer-tools and web development, and share Python/JavaScript expertise, but Lydia's deep experience in developer experience strategy and technical education could help Sid sharpen the positioning and usability of his side projects (social media tools, scheduling apps, developer utilities). Lydia's track record scaling adoption through great DX at Bun and Vercel, combined with her ability to communicate complex technical concepts visually, complements Sid's hands-on engineering focus.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Sid Kurra — Sid builds developer utilities and side projects in Python and JavaScript, and could benefit from your expertise in DX strategy and making technical tools more discoverable to engineers.
